text: Fourteen lessons of separate artifacts need to become one package before anything else in this chapter can start.

Right now it's scattered: a charter in a lab response, a CDE list in one lesson, SQL checks in a third. This lesson gathers all fourteen into one numbered package — Lesson 16 writes the synthesis on top of it.
The package starts with the charter, landscape inventory, CDE register, RACI, glossary and dictionary, classification, and the quality-check SQL — files one through seven, numbered in build order.
Files eight through fourteen continue it: lineage, authoritative sources, access and retention policy, KPIs and workflow, the operating model, the AI governance strategy, and the architecture.

Marcus runs four checks before calling it done: name consistency across files, CDE consistency between the register and later documents, decision consistency between Lesson 9 and Lesson 14, and whether every file says when it was last reviewed.

The check catches real drift — DateOfBirth shows up in Lesson 6's classification but not Lesson 3's register. A package with silent inconsistencies is worse than one with an honest gap, because it looks finished when it isn't.
Next: Lesson 16 turns this assembled package into one written enterprise governance strategy document.
